messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — auth-service reporter: high error rate from Auth0 /oauth/introspect (bulk) calls. >50% 504s for the last 5m, causing console session list and some API auth checks to fail. Paging oncall-sre.

sanjay: seeing it in dashboards, spike started ~10:02 UTC. console users report 'unable to verify session' and some customers hitting 401s.

brianna: confirmed — our health checks for admin session-sync are failing because we batch-introspect ~200 tokens per request. curl to introspect is timing out.

bjorn: putting the incident channel into triage. can we throttle/serialise the introspect calls from console to reduce pressure?

oncall-sre: acknowledged. I'm on it. grabbing logs and rate-limiting layer.

brianna: quick trace from 10:03:
```
HTTP 504 from https://auth0.example.com/oauth/introspect
trace id: 8f7a3c
latency: 10.2s
request: POST /oauth/introspect bulk
payload size: 12kb
```

sanjay: impact estimate — admin console: read operations (session list) time out; interactive login flows still mostly OK but account recovery flows use introspect and some customers hit 401. about 4% of production login traffic affected (rough estimate).

bjorn: opening support ticket w/ Auth0 now. @auth0-support can you escalate that this is high severity? we're seeing sustained 504s.

auth0-support: ticket #AUTH0-55432 opened with priority high. Auth0 engineering investigating possible service-side timeouts for bulk introspect. Requested logs and sample request.

oncall-sre: immediate mitigations we can do from our side: 1) disable bulk introspect path and fall back to per-token introspect with exponential backoff, 2) enable local session cache fallback for 5m TTL for console, 3) circuit-breaker to stop spamming Auth0 when error rate > 20%. Which do we want first?

brianna: do 2 + 3 now. local session cache is fast to flip (feature flag). circuit-breaker we can deploy with knob in gateway. I'll flip cache flag and patch gateway rate limiter.

sanjay: also reduce batch size from 200 -> 20 for now. that'll lower request pressure. If that helps, we can keep smaller batches until Auth0 confirms fix.

brianna: patch posted to staging and will roll to canary. command snippet:
```
# flip console session cache
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://console-api.internal/featureflags/session_cache -d '{"enabled":true,"ttl":300}'
```

oncall-sre: deploying gateway patch to add circuit-breaker (fail fast at 30% introspect 5xx in 1m window). Rolling to canary now.

bjorn: I'm communicating to support ops and accounts. Set status page? Impact is partial login verification and console session list degraded.

sanjay: status: public incident page draft: "We are investigating elevated errors with Auth0 token verification that may cause login failures and console session delays for a subset of users." Add note: workaround enabled — console read-only/no session refresh until further notice.

auth0-support: update from Auth0 — they see increased latencies on /oauth/introspect due to a backend datastore replication lag causing request amplification for bulk calls. Engineering working on mitigation; ETA unknown. Recommended that customers reduce batch sizes and reduce concurrency.

brianna: after cache + circuit-breaker + batch size reduction, error rate dropped from 55% -> 8% over 12m. console still has some read-only customers but API auth looks stable.

oncall-sre: monitoring shows token verification 5xx count trending down. continuing to monitor for 30m.

yasmin: customer impact note for postmortem: affected customers included two high-usage tenants (beta integrations) — they saw failed logins and admin console timeouts for ~18m before workaround fully effective. We'll need outreach.

bjorn: oncall handoff at 11:30 UTC to @sanjay. If Auth0 doesn't confirm full recovery, escalate to account team and consider temporary routing to Okta fallback for critical SSO customers (requires config change & risk eval).

sanjay: handoff acknowledged. my contact for postmortem is brianna. leaving this channel for now but reachable.

oncall-sre: final status at 11:43 UTC: mitigations holding, Auth0 internal mitigation in progress. Incidents-bot: mark P1 -> P2 at 11:43 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident CONV-2026-345 created. Postmortem assigned to brianna, timeline owner: sanjay, customer comms: bjorn.

brianna: notes for postmortem: root cause appears to be Auth0-side datastore replication lag -> amplified latency on bulk introspect path. Our resilient design (caching + circuit-breaker + smaller batches) reduced impact. Action items: add per-tenant rate cap on bulk introspect, document fallback to per-token introspect, test Okta routing plan for critical customers, and schedule follow-up with Auth0 engineering.

bjorn: thanks everyone — will prepare customer outreach and update status page with recovery note once Auth0 confirms. :thumbsup:

sanjay: +1. closing oncall handoff. I'll check back after Auth0 confirms full service recovery.
